paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.12 as of 2026-08-17, representing a decrease of 4.45% from the prior close and an increase of 1.07% over the last 22 trading sessions.

There is one new news item in the last 24 hours, with the headline "Fermi Receives Subpoena From Eastern District of New York Over Project Matador" from marketscreener.com, indicating that Fermi received a subpoena related to Project Matador.

Fermi Inc. has filed several recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with a disclosed annualized base salary and bonus structure.
